additional_info.subject: RE: ID0421167-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP/R8 170002420]  Connector 1 is showing unavailable CRM:02682000067
additional_info.body:
Hello Sadek,
Hope you are doing well.
As customer reported the issue Connector 1 is unavailable. Based on the logs we observed
DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100 with DC1 Errorcode:4, which implies that
charging cable temperature sensor error.
Please do the troubleshooting of the resistance on the plug via the connectors to the StateMonitor, please provide us photos and videos of the troubleshooting. I recommend you carry a spare CCS cable in case it needs replacement.
1) Check CC2 Plug if there is any water Ingress or Moisture or any physical damage
2) Please check PT1000 resistance value for DC1 in State Monitor KF14
3) Check tightness of cable at F03-XD410 terminals
4) IF PT1000 value is not OK then replace CC2 Cable
5) Also, please carry spare KF14
